4	/-!
5	# DataStack: a library administrative abstraction (contract DS-v2, non-normative)
6	
7	A `DataStack` instance of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`. The spec does not define
8	its contract (Part XIV preamble: "The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their
9	library abstractions and are not defined here"). The contract formalized here is the library
10	contract **DS-v2**, which is **not normative**: every definition below that encodes a DS-v2 item
11	says so. The normative clauses that constrain it are §36 (`MetaRight` requires `Modify` exercisable
12	on the stack value; the abstraction adds no rights to the kernel), §38 and §46 (library state
13	separate from `S₃`), §47 (empty initial registry), §56 (guard over all registries of live
14	administrations) and §58 (outcomes).
15	
16	DS-v2 is DS-v1 with six changes. DS-v1: marks carry the stack identity and a fresh mark
17	identifier; the stack keeps the ordered list of live marks; `rewind m` fails on a dead or foreign
18	mark, rejects if an active authority derived from `internal` covers a cell above `m`, otherwise
19	returns those cells to available and removes `m` and every mark above it; `push` and `grow` use the
20	derived `issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`: its static checks, the availability `fail`, then
21	`split` of `internal` and `store` of the block); `grow` is in place only (same base, extension into
22	the space directly after the block, `fail` otherwise). DS2-1: `mark` requires the administrative
23	right of §36 (`AdminRight`), else `reject`. DS2-2: `grow` stores the new block authority into the
24	place that currently holds the block authority `b`. DS2-3: a dead stack (`internal` inactive)
25	invalidates its marks, so `rewind` of a mark of a dead stack is `fail`, checked with the dead or
26	foreign mark, before the right. DS2-4: "a cell above m" is every cell at a position `≥ m.top`.
27	DS2-5: `grow` with `extra = 0` is accepted, an in-place reissue of the same region. DS2-6: `rewind`
28	on a stack index that does not exist is `fail`, like an invalid mark (`mark`, `push` and `grow` on
29	a missing stack stay `reject`). Also part of DS-v2: `push` without room is `fail`; `grow` of a `b`
30	that is no block of the stack is `reject`; §76.5 applies to `newStack`; the dead or foreign mark is
31	checked before the right of §36; §36 applies to `rewind`.
32	
33	Every `ok` step of the library is a sequence of kernel steps O1–O16 (`DReach.reachable`), so the
34	abstraction adds no rights to the kernel (§36).
35	-/
36	
37	namespace Ern.Lib.DataStack
38	
39	open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
40	
41	/-! ## Library state (DS-v2; §38, §46, §47) -/
42	
43	/-- A block issued by a stack (DS-v2, non-normative; recorded like the issuances of §46): position
44	`base` of its first cell and number `size` of cells among the ordered cells of the stack, block
45	authority `auth`, destination `dst` that received it (at `push`, or at the `grow` that issued it,
46	DS2-2). -/
47	structure Blk where
48	  base : Nat
49	  size : Nat
50	  auth : Nat
51	  dst : Nat
52	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
53	
54	/-- A mark (DS-v2, non-normative: "marks carry stack identity and a fresh mark identifier";
55	library metadata of an administrative abstraction, §36, §38): the identity of its stack, its fresh
56	identifier, the top of the stack when it was taken. -/
57	structure Mark where
58	  stack : Nat
59	  id : Nat
60	  top : Nat
61	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
62	
63	/-- A stack (DS-v2, non-normative; library state, §38, §46): administered storage, `internal`
64	authority held by the stack value (§36), ordered cells (the leaves of the storage at creation),
65	top (the cells at positions `≥ top` are available), issued blocks (oldest first), and the ordered
66	list of live marks (DS-v2: "the stack keeps the ordered list of live marks"). -/
67	structure Stack where
68	  storage : Nat
69	  internal : Nat
70	  cells : List Nat
71	  top : Nat
72	  blocks : List Blk
73	  marks : List Mark
74	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
75	
76	/-- State of the stack library (DS-v2, non-normative; §38: administrative states of library
77	abstractions are separate from `S₃`): the kernel state, the stack registry (a stack is identified
78	by its index; stacks are never removed) and the next fresh mark identifier. -/
79	structure DState where
80	  kern : S3
81	  stacks : List Stack
82	  fresh : Nat
83	
84	/-- Initial state (§47: the kernel's initial state; the library registry starts empty; DS-v2,
85	non-normative: no mark identifier given out). -/
86	def DState.init (statics : Statics) : DState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0⟩
87	
88	/-- The `n` cells from position `b` of the stack, leaves of the administered storage (§46; DS-v2,
89	non-normative). -/
90	def cellsOf (st : Stack) (b n : Nat) : List Nat := (st.cells.drop b).take n
91	
92	/-- The cells above mark `m` (DS-v2, non-normative, "a cell above m", DS2-4: every cell at a
93	position `≥ m.top`; §46 available leaves): `rewind m` returns those below the current top to
94	available, the others already are. -/
95	def above (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : List Nat := st.cells.drop m.top
96	
97	/-- The stack seen as an administration entry (§46, §36; DS-v2, non-normative): storage,
98	`internal`, available cells (positions `≥ top`) and issued blocks. Used for `MetaRight` and the
99	static checks of the derived `issue`, which read only the storage and `internal`. -/
100	def Stack.entry (st : Stack) : ArenaEntry :=
101	  ⟨st.storage, st.internal, st.cells.drop st.top,
102	    st.blocks.map fun x => (cellsOf st x.base x.size, x.auth)⟩
103	
104	/-- The block of the stack whose authority is `b` (§46 issuances; DS-v2, non-normative). -/
105	def Stack.block (st : Stack) (b : Nat) : Option Blk := st.blocks.find? fun y => decide (y.auth = b)
106	
107	/-- A live mark of stack `j` (DS-v2, non-normative: a mark that is neither dead nor foreign; it
108	decides the `fail` case of `rewind`, §58): the stack is live (`internal` is active, §46 read for a
109	stack; DS2-3: a dead stack invalidates its marks), the mark names stack `j` and it belongs to the
110	list of live marks of the stack. -/
111	def LiveMark (s : S3) (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Prop :=
112	  s.Active st.internal ∧ m.stack = j ∧ m ∈ st.marks
113	
114	/-- Decidability of `LiveMark` (§58; DS-v2). -/
115	instance (s : S3) (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Decidable (LiveMark s j st m) := by
116	  unfold LiveMark; infer_instance
117	
118	/-- The administrative right of §36 for a stack (DS-v2, non-normative, with §36 and §46 read for a
119	stack): the stack is live (`internal` is active) and `MetaRight`, `Modify` exercisable on the stack
120	value, the place holding `internal`. -/
121	def AdminRight (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Prop := s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRight s st.entry
122	
123	/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36; DS-v2). -/
124	instance (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Decidable (AdminRight s st) := by
125	  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance
126	
127	/-! ## `newStack` and the guard of §56 -/
128	
129	/-- The stack registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; DS-v2, non-normative): the
130	`internal` identities of its live stacks. -/
131	def stackInternals (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) : List Nat :=
132	  (stacks.filter fun st => decide (s.Active st.internal)).map (·.internal)
133	
134	/-- Preconditions of `newStack(storage, internal)` (DS-v2, non-normative; §56): those of `newArena`
135	other than its guard (`NewArenaBase`, §76.1–§76.3, §76.5 and §76.6 read for a stack), and the guard
136	of §56 over the stack registry and every other registry of live administrations `others`. -/
137	structure NewStackPre (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat))
138	    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
139	  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, §76.6, read for a stack (DS-v2). -/
140	  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
141	  /-- §56: no live administration of any registry uses `internal`. -/
142	  guard : Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal
143	
144	/-- Decidability of `NewStackPre` (§56; DS-v2). -/
145	instance (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
146	    Decidable (NewStackPre s stacks others storage internal) :=
147	  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
148	    Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal)
149	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
150	
151	/-- Effect of `newStack` (DS-v2, non-normative; §36: registration adds no rights): a stack whose
152	cells are the leaves of the storage, top 0, no block, no mark; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
153	def newStackEff (D : DState) (storage internal : Nat) : DState :=
154	  { D with stacks := D.stacks ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint D.kern.P storage, 0, [], []⟩] }
155	
156	/-- `newStack` as a relation (DS-v2, non-normative; §56, §58): `ok` or `reject`. -/
157	def NewStackStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (D : DState) :
158	    Outcome3 DState → Prop :=
159	  Guarded (NewStackPre D.kern D.stacks others storage internal) (newStackEff D storage internal)
160	
161	/-! ## `push` (DS-v2: the derived `issue`, Part XIV, §77) -/
162	
163	/-- Metadata after `push` (DS-v2, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
164	cells leave the available part (the top rises by `size`), the block is recorded. -/
165	def pushMeta (st : Stack) (size a dst : Nat) : Stack :=
166	  { st with top := st.top + size, blocks := st.blocks ++ [⟨st.top, size, a, dst⟩] }
167	
168	/-- `push(j, size, dst)` (DS-v2, non-normative: "push uses the derived issue"): the derived `issue`
169	of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the `size` cells at the top into `dst`, on the stack seen as an
170	entry: its static checks (`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2, with `MetaRight` of §36), then `fail`, the
171	state unchanged, when fewer than `size` cells are left (availability, §77.4; DS-v2, Q11 (a)),
172	then `split` of `internal` on the cells (O2) and `store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into
173	`dst` (O8). -/
174	inductive PushStep (k : K) (j size dst : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
175	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
176	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
177	      ¬ IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
178	  | fail {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
179	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
180	      ¬ st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length → PushStep k j size dst D .fail
181	  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
182	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
183	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
184	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern .reject →
185	      PushStep k j size dst D .reject
186	  | store {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
187	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
188	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
189	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
190	      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
191	  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
192	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
193	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
194	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
195	      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
196	      PushStep k j size dst D
197	        (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (pushMeta st size D.kern.A.length dst), D.fresh⟩)
198	
199	/-! ## `mark` (DS-v2) -/
200	
201	/-- Metadata after `mark` (DS-v2, non-normative; library metadata, §36, §38): a mark naming stack
202	`j`, with the fresh identifier `fresh` and the current top, is appended to the live marks. -/
203	def markMeta (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (fresh : Nat) : Stack :=
204	  { st with marks := st.marks ++ [⟨j, fresh, st.top⟩] }
205	
206	/-- `mark(j)` (DS-v2, non-normative; §58 outcomes): `reject` on a missing stack; `reject` without
207	the administrative right of §36 (DS2-1); otherwise `ok`, metadata only (no right created, §36), the
208	identifier is fresh. -/
209	inductive MarkStep (j : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
210	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → MarkStep j D .reject
211	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → ¬ AdminRight D.kern st → MarkStep j D .reject
212	  | ok {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → AdminRight D.kern st →
213	      MarkStep j D (.ok ⟨D.kern, D.stacks.set j (markMeta j st D.fresh), D.fresh + 1⟩)
214	
215	/-- `mark_rejects_without_right` (DS-v2, non-normative, DS2-1: `mark` requires `AdminRight` on the
216	stack, else `reject`; §36, §58): on an existing stack without the administrative right of §36,
217	`mark` has the outcome `reject` and no other. -/
218	theorem mark_rejects_without_right {j : Nat} {D : DState} {st : Stack}
219	    (hst : D.stacks[j]? = some st) (ha : ¬ AdminRight D.kern st) :
220	    MarkStep j D .reject ∧ ∀ o, MarkStep j D o → o = .reject := by
221	  refine ⟨.static hst ha, fun o ho => ?_⟩
222	  cases ho with
223	  | noStack => rfl
224	  | static => rfl
225	  | ok h ha' => rw [hst] at h; cases h; exact absurd ha' ha
226	
227	/-! ## `rewind` (DS-v2) -/
228	
229	/-- Metadata after `rewind m` (DS-v2, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §78 on §46 metadata):
230	the cells above `m` return to available (the top returns to the top of `m`), the blocks from that
231	top are forgotten, `m` and every later mark are removed. -/
232	def rewindMeta (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Stack :=
233	  { st with
234	    top := m.top
235	    blocks := st.blocks.filter fun x => decide (x.base < m.top)
236	    marks := st.marks.takeWhile fun x => decide (x ≠ m) }
237	
238	/-- `rewind(j, m)` (DS-v2, non-normative): `fail`, the state unchanged, on a missing stack (DS2-6)
239	and on a dead or foreign mark, a mark of a dead stack included (DS2-3), before the right; `reject`
240	without the administrative right of §36; then the derived `reset` of Part XIV on the cells above
241	`m` (DS2-4): `split` of `internal` on them (O2), which rejects when an active authority derived from
242	`internal` covers one of them (`rewind_rejects_live_above`), and `release` of the derived authority
243	(O3); `ok`: the cells return to available, `m` and the later marks are removed. -/
244	inductive RewindStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (m : Mark) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
245	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → RewindStep k j m D .fail
246	  | dead {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → ¬ LiveMark D.kern j st m →
247	      RewindStep k j m D .fail
248	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark D.kern j st m →
249	      ¬ AdminRight D.kern st → RewindStep k j m D .reject
250	  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark D.kern j st m → AdminRight D.kern st →
251	      SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
252	  | release {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark D.kern j st m →
253	      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
254	      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
255	  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark D.kern j st m →
256	      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
257	      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) →
258	      RewindStep k j m D (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (rewindMeta st m), D.fresh⟩)
259	
260	/-- `rewind` has one outcome (§58: a guarded transition has one outcome; DS-v2, non-normative):
261	the cases of `RewindStep` exclude each other, the two `fail` cases (missing stack, DS2-6; dead or
262	foreign mark) give the same outcome, and `split` and `release` are deterministic (`Guarded.det`).
263	With `rewind_ok_iff`, an `ok` rewind is never also `reject` or `fail`. -/
264	theorem RewindStep.det {k : K} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} {D : DState} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 DState}
265	    (h₁ : RewindStep k j m D o₁) (h₂ : RewindStep k j m D o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
266	  cases h₁ with
267	  | noStack h =>
268	    cases h₂ with
269	    | noStack _ => rfl
270	    | dead _ _ => rfl
271	    | static h' _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
272	    | split h' _ _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
273	    | release h' _ _ _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
274	    | ok h' _ _ _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
275	  | dead h hl =>
276	    cases h₂ with
277	    | noStack _ => rfl
278	    | dead _ _ => rfl
279	    | static h' hl' _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl' hl
280	    | split h' hl' _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl' hl
281	    | release h' hl' _ _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl' hl
282	    | ok h' hl' _ _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl' hl
283	  | static h hl ha =>
284	    cases h₂ with
285	    | noStack h' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
286	    | dead h' hl' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl hl'
287	    | static _ _ _ => rfl
288	    | split _ _ _ _ => rfl
289	    | release _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
290	    | ok h' _ ha' _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd ha' ha
291	  | split h hl _ hs =>
292	    cases h₂ with
293	    | noStack h' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
294	    | dead h' hl' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl hl'
295	    | static _ _ _ => rfl
296	    | split _ _ _ _ => rfl
297	    | release _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
298	    | ok h' _ _ hs' _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'
299	  | release h hl _ hs hr =>
300	    cases h₂ with
301	    | noStack h' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
302	    | dead h' hl' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl hl'
303	    | static _ _ _ => rfl
304	    | split _ _ _ _ => rfl
305	    | release _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
306	    | ok h' _ _ hs' hr' =>
307	      rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'; cases Guarded.det hr hr'
308	  | ok h hl ha hs hr =>
309	    cases h₂ with
310	    | noStack h' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
311	    | dead h' hl' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl hl'
312	    | static h' _ ha' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd ha ha'
313	    | split h' _ _ hs' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'
314	    | release h' _ _ hs' hr' =>
315	      rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'; cases Guarded.det hr hr'
316	    | ok h' _ _ hs' hr' =>
317	      rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'; cases Guarded.det hr hr'; rfl
318	
319	/-- `rewind_missing_fails` (DS-v2, non-normative, DS2-6: `rewind` on a stack index that does not
320	exist is `fail`, like an invalid mark, before the right of §36; §58 `fail`): on a missing stack,
321	`rewind m` fails, with no other outcome, for every mark `m`. -/
322	theorem rewind_missing_fails {k : K} {D : DState} {j : Nat} {m : Mark}
323	    (h : D.stacks[j]? = none) :
324	    RewindStep k j m D .fail ∧ ∀ o, RewindStep k j m D o → o = .fail :=
325	  ⟨.noStack h, fun _ ho => ho.det (.noStack h)⟩
326	
327	/-! ## `grow` (DS-v2: in place, the derived `issue`) -/
328	
329	/-- In-place extension (DS-v2, non-normative: "extension into the space directly after the
330	block"; the availability check of the derived `issue`, §77.4): `extra` is zero, the empty
331	extension, always available (§77.4: "The empty region is always available"; DS2-5: an in-place
332	reissue of the same region), or the block ends at the top and `extra` available cells follow it. -/
333	def InPlace (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Prop :=
334	  extra = 0 ∨ (x.base + x.size = st.top ∧ st.top + extra ≤ st.cells.length)
335	
336	/-- Decidability of `InPlace` (§77.4; DS-v2). -/
337	instance (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Decidable (InPlace st x extra) := by
338	  unfold InPlace; infer_instance
339	
340	/-- The grown block (DS-v2, non-normative: same base, `extra` more cells, new authority `a`,
341	destination `d`, the place that held the authority of the block, DS2-2; an issuance of §46). -/
342	def growBlk (x : Blk) (extra a d : Nat) : Blk := ⟨x.base, x.size + extra, a, d⟩
343	
344	/-- Metadata after `grow` (DS-v2, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
345	top rises by `extra`; the block is replaced by the grown block. -/
346	def growMeta (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra a d : Nat) : Stack :=
347	  { st with
348	    top := st.top + extra
349	    blocks := st.blocks.map fun y => if y.auth = x.auth then growBlk x extra a d else y }
350	
351	/-- The place that holds authority `a`, if a place holds it (§42: holder; DS-v2, non-normative,
352	DS2-2: the destination of `grow` is the place that currently holds the block authority). -/
353	def holderPlace (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Option Nat :=
354	  match s.A[a]? with
355	  | some y => match y.holder with
356	    | .place v => some v
357	    | .frame _ => none
358	  | none => none
359	
360	/-- `grow(j, b, extra)` (DS-v2, non-normative: in place only, using the derived `issue`): `reject`
361	when `b` is not a block of the stack; `extra` may be zero, an in-place reissue of the same region
362	(DS2-5); `release` of `b` (O3); then the derived
363	`issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the region of the same base and of size `size + extra` into
364	the place `d` that holds `b` when `grow` starts (DS2-2), on the released state: `reject` when no
365	place holds `b` (there is no destination, §77.2; never on library-reachable states,
366	`DReach.grow_holder`), its static checks (`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2), `fail`, the state
367	unchanged, unless the extension is in place (DS-v1 "fail otherwise", availability §77.4), `split`
368	of `internal` (O2) and `store` of the new block into `d` (O8). -/
369	inductive GrowStep (k : K) (j b extra : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
370	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
371	  | noBlock {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = none →
372	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
373	  | release {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
374	      ReleaseStep b D.kern .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
375	  | noHolder {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
376	      ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) → holderPlace D.kern b = none →
377	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
378	  | static {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} {d : Nat} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
379	      st.block b = some x → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
380	      holderPlace D.kern b = some d →
381	      ¬ IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) d →
382	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
383	  | fail {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} {d : Nat} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
384	      st.block b = some x → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
385	      holderPlace D.kern b = some d →
386	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) d →
387	      ¬ InPlace st x extra → GrowStep k j b extra D .fail
388	  | split {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} {d : Nat} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
389	      st.block b = some x → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
390	      holderPlace D.kern b = some d →
391	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) d → InPlace st x extra →
392	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ .reject →
393	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
394	  | store {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ : S3} {d : Nat} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
395	      st.block b = some x → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
396	      holderPlace D.kern b = some d →
397	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) d → InPlace st x extra →
398	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
399	      StoreStep s₁.A.length d s₂ .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
400	  | ok {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S3} {d : Nat} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
401	      st.block b = some x → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
402	      holderPlace D.kern b = some d →
403	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) d → InPlace st x extra →
404	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
405	      StoreStep s₁.A.length d s₂ (.ok s₃) →
406	      GrowStep k j b extra D
407	        (.ok ⟨s₃, D.stacks.set j (growMeta st x extra s₁.A.length d), D.fresh⟩)
408	
409	/-! ## Library runs (DS-v2; §36, §56, §57) -/
410	
411	/-- One `ok` step of the stack library (DS-v2, non-normative): a kernel step O1–O16 of
412	non-administrative code, the registry unchanged; `newStack` with the guard of §56 against the other
413	registries `others`; `push`, `mark`, `rewind`, `grow`. -/
414	inductive DStep (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
415	  | kernel {D : DState} {s' : S3} : KStep k D.kern s' → DStep k D ⟨s', D.stacks, D.fresh⟩
416	  | newStack {D D' : DState} {others : List (List Nat)} {storage i : Nat} :
417	      NewStackStep others storage i D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
418	  | push {D D' : DState} {j size dst : Nat} : PushStep k j size dst D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
419	  | mark {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} : MarkStep j D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
420	  | rewind {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} : RewindStep k j m D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
421	  | grow {D D' : DState} {j b extra : Nat} : GrowStep k j b extra D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
422	
423	/-- States reachable from the initial state by library steps (DS-v2, non-normative; §47). -/
424	inductive DReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : DState → Prop where
425	  | init : DReach k statics (DState.init statics)
426	  | step {D D' : DState} : DReach k statics D → DStep k D D' → DReach k statics D'
427	
428	/-- Finite sequences of library steps (DS-v2, non-normative; §58 `ok` transitions). -/
429	inductive DRun (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
430	  | refl (D : DState) : DRun k D D
431	  | tail {D D' D'' : DState} : DRun k D D' → DStep k D' D'' → DRun k D D''
432	
433	/-- The kernel part of a library step is reached by kernel steps (§36: the abstraction adds no
434	rights to the kernel; Part XIV: `issue` is `split` then `store`, the reset part of `rewind` is
435	`split` then `release`; DS-v2). -/
436	theorem DStep.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D D' : DState}
437	    (hr : Reachable k statics D.kern) (h : DStep k D D') : Reachable k statics D'.kern := by
438	  cases h with
439	  | kernel hk => exact .step hr hk
440	  | newStack hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hr
441	  | push hs =>
442	    cases hs with
443	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
444	  | mark hs => cases hs with | ok _ _ => exact hr
445	  | rewind hs =>
446	    cases hs with
447	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hrl => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.release hrl)
448	  | grow hs =>
449	    cases hs with
450	    | ok _ _ hrl _ _ _ hsp hst =>
451	      exact .step (.step (.step hr (.release hrl)) (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
452	
453	/-- The kernel state of every library-reachable state is kernel-reachable (§36, §57; DS-v2). -/
454	theorem DReach.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D : DState} (h : DReach k statics D) :
455	    Reachable k statics D.kern := by
456	  induction h with
457	  | init => exact .init
458	  | step _ hs ih => exact hs.reachable ih
459	
460	/-! ## Helper lemmas (lists, kernel effects) -/

/-- Computed outcome of `push(j, size, dst)` (DS-v2; Part XIV, §77; §58). -/
def pushOut (D : DataStack.DState) (j size dst : Nat) : Outcome3 DataStack.DState :=
  match D.stacks[j]? with
  | none => .reject
  | some st =>
    if IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (DataStack.cellsOf st st.top size) dst then
      if st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length then
        if SplitPre k D.kern st.internal [DataStack.cellsOf st st.top size] then
          if StorePre (splitEff D.kern st.internal [DataStack.cellsOf st st.top size])
              D.kern.A.length dst then
            .ok ⟨storeEff (splitEff D.kern st.internal [DataStack.cellsOf st st.top size])
              D.kern.A.length dst,
              D.stacks.set j (DataStack.pushMeta st size D.kern.A.length dst), D.fresh⟩
          else .reject
        else .reject
      else .fail
    else .reject

/-- Computed outcome of `mark(j)` (DS-v2, DS2-1: `AdminRight` required, §36; §58). -/
def markOut (D : DataStack.DState) (j : Nat) : Outcome3 DataStack.DState :=
  match D.stacks[j]? with
  | none => .reject
  | some st =>
    if DataStack.AdminRight D.kern st then
      .ok ⟨D.kern, D.stacks.set j (DataStack.markMeta j st D.fresh), D.fresh + 1⟩
    else .reject

/-- Computed outcome of `rewind(j, m)` (DS-v2, DS2-3, DS2-4, DS2-6: a missing stack and a dead or
foreign mark `fail` before the right; Part XIV, §78; §58). -/
def rewindOut (D : DataStack.DState) (j : Nat) (m : DataStack.Mark) :
    Outcome3 DataStack.DState :=
  match D.stacks[j]? with
  | none => .fail
  | some st =>
    if DataStack.LiveMark D.kern j st m then
      if DataStack.AdminRight D.kern st then
        if SplitPre k D.kern st.internal [DataStack.above st m] then
          if ReleasePre (splitEff D.kern st.internal [DataStack.above st m])
              D.kern.A.length then
            .ok ⟨releaseEff (splitEff D.kern st.internal [DataStack.above st m])
              D.kern.A.length, D.stacks.set j (DataStack.rewindMeta st m), D.fresh⟩
          else .reject
        else .reject
      else .reject
    else .fail

/-- Computed outcome of `grow(j, b, extra)` (DS-v2, DS2-2: into the place that holds `b`; DS2-5:
`extra` may be zero; Part XIV, §77; §58). -/
def growOut (D : DataStack.DState) (j b extra : Nat) : Outcome3 DataStack.DState :=
  match D.stacks[j]? with
  | none => .reject
  | some st =>
    match st.block b with
    | none => .reject
    | some x =>
      if ReleasePre D.kern b then
        match DataStack.holderPlace D.kern b with
        | none => .reject
        | some d =>
          if IssueStatic (releaseEff D.kern b) st.entry
              (DataStack.cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) d then
            if DataStack.InPlace st x extra then
              if SplitPre k (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal
                  [DataStack.cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] then
                if StorePre (splitEff (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal
                    [DataStack.cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)])
                    (releaseEff D.kern b).A.length d then
                  .ok ⟨storeEff (splitEff (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal
                      [DataStack.cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)])
                      (releaseEff D.kern b).A.length d,
                    D.stacks.set j (DataStack.growMeta st x extra (releaseEff D.kern b).A.length d),
                    D.fresh⟩
                else .reject
              else .reject
            else .fail
          else .reject
      else .reject

/-- The computed outcome of `o` from `C` (§58, §60–§78; HandlePool v0.5; DS-v2): the
executor of `Ern.Corpus` on the arena projection for O1–O16, `issue` and `reset`; the guard of §56
over all registries for the creation operations; the pool and stack executors above. -/
def cstep (C : CState) : COp → Outcome3 CState
  | .derive a r m => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.derive a r m))
  | .split a rs => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.split a rs))
  | .release a => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.release a))
  | .transfer a b => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.transfer a b))
  | .depend q x => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.depend q x))
  | .enter ps ls => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.enter ps ls))
  | .exit => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL .exit)
  | .read a ls => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.read a ls))
  | .write a ls => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.write a ls))
  | .writeShared a ls => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.writeShared a ls))
  | .pin p => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.pin p))
  | .unpin o => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.unpin o))
  | .endUse p => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.endUse p))
  | .free p a => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.free p a))
  | .alloc pr ow ls => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.alloc pr ow ls))
  | .store a p => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.store a p))
  | .newArena st i =>
    if NewArenaPre C.kern C.arenas C.othersA st i then .ok (C.setL (newArenaEff C.toL st i))
    else .reject
  | .issue i r d => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.issue i r d))
  | .reset i => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.reset i))
  | .newPool st i =>
    if HandlePool.NewPoolPre C.kern C.pools C.othersP st i then
      .ok (C.setP (HandlePool.newPoolEff C.toP st i))
    else .reject
  | .allocSlot j d => liftO C.setP (allocSlotOut C.toP j d)
  | .resolve j h m => liftO C.setP (resolveOut C.toP j h m)
  | .resolveMany j hs m => liftO C.setP (resolveManyOut k C.toP j hs m)
  | .unresolve c => liftO C.setP (unresolveOut C.toP c)
  | .freeSlot j h => liftO C.setP (freeSlotOut C.toP j h)
  | .newStack st i =>
    if DataStack.NewStackPre C.kern C.stacks C.othersD st i then
      .ok (C.setD (DataStack.newStackEff C.toD st i))
    else .reject
  | .push j n d => liftO C.setD (pushOut k C.toD j n d)
  | .mark j => liftO C.setD (markOut C.toD j)
  | .rewind j m => liftO C.setD (rewindOut k C.toD j m)
  | .grow j b e => liftO C.setD (growOut k C.toD j b e)

/-- `pushOut` is an outcome of `PushStep` (DS-v2; §58). -/
theorem pushOut_sound (D : DataStack.DState) (j size dst : Nat) :
    DataStack.PushStep k j size dst D (pushOut k D j size dst) := by
  unfold pushOut
  split
  · next hj => exact .noStack hj
  · next st hj =>
    split
    · next hs =>
      split
      · next hn =>
        split
        · next h1 =>
          split
          · next h2 => exact .ok hj hs hn (.ok h1) (.ok h2)
          · next h2 => exact .store hj hs hn (.ok h1) (.reject h2)
        · next h1 => exact .split hj hs hn (.reject h1)
      · next hn => exact .fail hj hs hn
    · next hs => exact .static hj hs

/-- `markOut` is an outcome of `MarkStep` (DS-v2; §58). -/
theorem markOut_sound (D : DataStack.DState) (j : Nat) :
    DataStack.MarkStep j D (markOut D j) := by
  unfold markOut
  split
  · next hj => exact .noStack hj
  · next st hj =>
    split
    · next ha => exact .ok hj ha
    · next ha => exact .static hj ha

theorem rewindOut_sound (D : DataStack.DState) (j : Nat) (m : DataStack.Mark) :
    DataStack.RewindStep k j m D (rewindOut k D j m) := by
  unfold rewindOut
  split
  · next hj => exact .noStack hj
  · next st hj =>
    split
    · next hl =>
      split
      · next ha =>
        split
        · next h1 =>
          split
          · next h2 => exact .ok hj hl ha (.ok h1) (.ok h2)
          · next h2 => exact .release hj hl ha (.ok h1) (.reject h2)
        · next h1 => exact .split hj hl ha (.reject h1)
      · next ha => exact .static hj hl ha
    · next hl => exact .dead hj hl

theorem growOut_sound (D : DataStack.DState) (j b extra : Nat) :
    DataStack.GrowStep k j b extra D (growOut k D j b extra) := by
  unfold growOut
  split
  · next hj => exact .noStack hj
  · next st hj =>
    split
    · next hb => exact .noBlock hj hb
    · next x hb =>
      split
      · next h0 =>
        split
        · next hh => exact .noHolder hj hb (.ok h0) hh
        · next d hh =>
          split
          · next hs =>
            split
            · next hi =>
              split
              · next h1 =>
                split
                · next h2 => exact .ok hj hb (.ok h0) hh hs hi (.ok h1) (.ok h2)
                · next h2 => exact .store hj hb (.ok h0) hh hs hi (.ok h1) (.reject h2)
              · next h1 => exact .split hj hb (.ok h0) hh hs hi (.reject h1)
            · next hi => exact .fail hj hb (.ok h0) hh hs hi
          · next hs => exact .static hj hb (.ok h0) hh hs
      · next h0 => exact .release hj hb (.reject h0)

/-- **Step soundness** (§58, §60–§78; HandlePool v0.5; DS-v2): the computed outcome of `o`
from `C` is an outcome of the relation of `o` on the projected state, `ok`, `reject` and `fail`
alike. -/
theorem cstep_sound (C : CState) (o : COp) : CRel k C o (cstep k C o) := by
  cases o with
  | newArena st i => exact liftR_guarded
  | newPool st i => exact liftR_guarded
  | newStack st i => exact liftR_guarded
  | allocSlot j d => exact liftR_liftO (allocSlotOut_sound _ _ _)
  | resolve j h m => exact liftR_liftO (resolveOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | resolveMany j hs m => exact liftR_liftO (resolveManyOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | unresolve c => exact liftR_liftO (unresolveOut_sound _ _)
  | freeSlot j h => exact liftR_liftO (freeSlotOut_sound _ _ _)
  | push j n d => exact liftR_liftO (pushOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | mark j => exact liftR_liftO (markOut_sound _ _)
  | rewind j m => exact liftR_liftO (rewindOut_sound _ _ _)
  | grow j b e => exact liftR_liftO (growOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | _ => exact liftR_liftO (lstep_sound _ _)

/-- A computed `reject` is a `reject` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
theorem crejects {C : CState} {o : COp} (h : verdictOf (cstep k C o) = .reject) :
    CRel k C o .reject := by
  have hs := cstep_sound (k := k) C o

18:- No sorry, admit, native_decide, axiom, noncomputable or set_option in the file.
20:- The same scratch file checks with `decide` that the new instances evaluate:
28:- Callers outside my scope still treat the `unpin` argument and `ExternalDone` as a place. Corpus/MM3H.lean:551-563 (H26) uses `KPd` with `done := [2]`, `UnpinStep KP 2` and `.pin 2, .unpin 2`. Under v0.1 the only obligation in h26 has identity 0, so `.unpin 2` designates an obligation that does not exist. The twin would then be rejected, and the `UnpinStep KP 2 .reject` conjunct would hold for a different reason (no obligation 2, not a missing ExternalDone). The MM3H agent must decide this from §75. Corpus/MM23H.lean:372-380 (R1: `done := [3]`, `.pin 3 ... .unpin 3`) has the same problem, but it runs on its own KOp runner, not this one.
30:- `NewArenaPre` now makes `decide` evaluate WF3, I1, AnchorOrder, AnchorOrderHeld and ArenaInv on every newArena step. On the H11-sized run this was fast (whole scratch file about 0.8 s). I did not measure the larger corpus runs.

65:| H50_issue | To arbitrate (material); v0 MISMATCH in form, obtained reject | The material left issue into a leaf of the region open | reject, static (by arbitration, verdict = obtained) | §77.2 second sentence (destination not in region; §88) | reject; twin issue into value 2: ok | none |
102:- No sorry, admit, native_decide, axiom, noncomputable or set_option in the file, and no line over 100 characters.
107:- MM23-H16 (spec gap, non-blocking per the task, which requires it to pass): the lowest-address rule for a region with a leaf of nonzero size is still a reconstruction decision recorded for §82.3. v0.1 §82.2 decides only regions whose leaves all have zero physical size.
123:- The three owned files contain no sorry, admit, native_decide, axiom, noncomputable or set_option.
130:- The two `endUse` steps are `reject`, against the baseline's `ok`, decided by v0.1 §69.2, which overrides the baseline for those two steps.
150:- minor formal/Ern/Corpus/MM3H.lean:761-775 (H49 docstring, "New expected verdict (spec v0.1, by arbitration the obtained one)"): The docstring says the new endUse verdicts come "by arbitration the obtained one", but they do not. When Q21 fixed H49's regression verdict as "verdict = verdict obtenu", the obtained verdict was the v0 one: endUse 2 and endUse 3 ok, then reset reject, with 7 and 8 still active. The new verdict (endUse 2 and 3 reject) comes only from the v0.1 amendment of §69.2 (last sentence, the Q9 follow-up), which overrides the Q21 baseline. The verdict is correct and the clause is cited, so the change is not silent. Only the stated source is wrong: the text should say the v0.1 §69.2 amendment overrides the Q21 regression baseline, not that the verdict was taken from the obtained outcome, which the brief forbids. EVIDENCE: HEAD docstring (git diff of MM3H.lean): "after the `endUse` of the block values 2 and 3 they stay so, active ... and `reset` is `reject`", with `RunsTo K0 [] (h49o ++ [.endUse 2, .endUse 3]) h49e`, so endUse was ok. Blocking report B14 (scratchpad/ref/blocking-report.md:96): "obtained `ok`, residual blocking, `reset` `reject`". Q21: "H49 : conservé comme test de régression, verdict = verdict obtenu". v0.1 §69.2 adds: "no authority that the effect makes inactive ... has an active descendant ... that the same step does not make inactive". My re-derivation: endUse 2 makes block 5 inactive. Its descendant 8 (origin 5, held by leaf 6) stays active, so reject. Same for endUse 3 with block 6 and its descendant 7. Scratch check review-corpus/H49Check.lean, `lake env lean` clean: every EndUsePre field except keptDesc holds for endUse 2 and 3 on h49 (`EndUseBut K0 h49.kern 2/3` by decide). The v0.1 amendment alone causes the rejection. Brief: "Derive the new expected verdict from the v0.1 text, never from the obtained outcome."
151:- minor formal/Ern/Corpus/MM23H.lean:32-37 (module header) and :815-817 (MM23-H16 docstring): The rewritten docstrings say the lowest-address rule (a region with a leaf of nonzero size gets the lowest address among those leaves) is "a decision of the reconstruction recorded for §82.3". That rule came from the user's brief, and the HEAD text credited it to the brief. The new wording presents a user decision as an interpretation the reconstruction chose itself, which AGENTS.md forbids. MM23-H16 is the case that rests on this rule. Its verdict has no v0.1 source, and the header (lines 28-29) says such a case is 'kept with its expected verdict and classified', yet the file gives it no open-boundary or arbitration classification. The case itself passes.     | some st =>
      if LiveMark D.kern j st m then'''

new_grow='''      | some x =>
        if ReleasePre D.kern b then
          match holderPlace D.kern b with
          | none => .reject
          | some d =>

              if InPlace st x extra then
                if SplitPre k (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal
                    [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] then
                  if StorePre (splitEff (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal
                      [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)]) (releaseEff D.kern b).A.length d then
                    .ok ⟨storeEff (splitEff (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal
                        [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)]) (releaseEff D.kern b).A.length d,
                      D.stacks.set j (growMeta st x extra (releaseEff D.kern b).A.length d),
                      D.fresh⟩
                  else .reject
                else .reject
              else .fail
            else .reject
        else .reject

'''
s=s.replace(old_grow,new_grow)

  | push'''
new_ms='''    · next st h =>
      split
      · next ha => exact .ok h ha
      · next ha => exact .static h ha
  | push'''
assert s.count(old_ms)==1
s=s.replace(old_ms,new_ms)
old_gs=s[s.index('      · next x hb =>\n        split\n        · next h0 =>'):s.index('/-- An `ok` computed step is a library step')]
new_gs='''      · next x hb =>
        split
        · next h0 =>
          split
          · next hh => exact .noHolder h hb (.ok h0) hh
          · next d hh =>
            split
            · next hs =>
              split
              · next hi =>
                split
                · next h1 =>
                  split
                  · next h2 => exact .ok h hb (.ok h0) hh hs hi (.ok h1) (.ok h2)
                  · next h2 => exact .store h hb (.ok h0) hh hs hi (.ok h1) (.reject h2)
                · next h1 => exact .split h hb (.ok h0) hh hs hi (.reject h1)
              · next hi => exact .fail h hb (.ok h0) hh hs hi
            · next hs => exact .static h hb (.ok h0) hh hs
        · next h0 => exact .release h hb (.reject h0)

'''
s=s.replace(old_gs,new_gs)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

import Ern.Lib.DataStack

/-!
# Corpus DataStack: the stack library (test module)

Cases of the library instance `DataStack` of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`, run on
the reference kernel (§60–§75) through the library of `Ern.Lib.DataStack`. The spec does not define
the contract (Part XIV preamble: "The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their
library abstractions and are not defined here"); the contract is DS-v2, non-normative, quoted in the
module docstring of `Ern.Lib.DataStack`. This is a test module: no model or library module imports
it.

* `DOp`: a kernel operation O1–O16 of the corpus runner (`Ern.Corpus.Runner`), or a stack
  operation `newStack`, `push`, `mark`, `rewind`, `grow` (DS-v2).
* `dstep k D o`: the computed outcome (§58); `dstep_sound`: it is an outcome of the relation of the
  operation (`DOpRel`: the kernel relation with the stack metadata unchanged, `NewStackStep`,
  `PushStep`, `MarkStep`, `RewindStep`, `GrowStep`), `ok`, `reject` and `fail` alike.
* `druns`: a run from `DState.init statics` (§47) whose steps are all `ok` reaches a state that is
  library-reachable (`DReach`) and whose kernel state is reachable by O1–O16 (§57,
  `DReach.reachable`).
* `newStack` consults the stack registry and no other (§56, `others = []`): the library states of
  these runs hold no administration other than stacks.

Each case states the reached state with `DRunsTo`, the verdict of the step under test with the
relation of its operation on that state (decided by `decide`; `rewind_dead_fails` adds that `fail`
is the only outcome), and its positive twin (the same sequence without the faulty element,
accepted). Its docstring gives the expected verdict from its source (DS-v2; the brief; the draft
DataStack cases of the derivability material, non-normative, which settle no verdict alone), the
obtained verdict, the class (`Lib`: library instance) and the twin. A case whose obtained verdict
differs from the expected one is kept with its expected verdict and marked **MISMATCH**. Two
verdicts have no settling source and are marked to arbitrate (expected verdict from the source:
none; **MISMATCH** in form, as `pool_free_entry_handle` in `Ern.Corpus.Lib`): DS05 (`push` without
room, reading DS-R7) and the third `grow` of DS03 (`grow` of a block that is no block of the
stack, reading DS-R5).

Readings of DS-v2 (recorded with `Ern.Lib.DataStack`) on which a verdict depends: DS-R5 (`grow` of
a live block that is not the last one: `fail`; the draft rejected) in DS04, and (a `b` that is no
block: `reject`; alternative `fail`) in DS03; DS-R7 (`push` without room: `fail`) in DS05. The runs
use the representation reading R3 (`rewind` as `split` and `release` of `internal`, with the right
of §36) and the readings DS-R9 at every `newStack` (formerly R5: the preconditions of `newArena`
other than its guard, §76.5 included, and the guard of §56), DS-R10 at every `mark` (formerly R6:
no right required) and DS-R11 at every `grow` (formerly R7: the recorded destination), which change
verdicts or arrival states in other programs but not here. The other verdicts are the same under
the alternatives of DS-R1, DS-R2, DS-R3, DS-R6, DS-R9, DS-R10, DS-R11 and R4: the covering
authorities lie between the top of the mark and the top; the administrative right of §36 holds
where a mark is dead or foreign; a foreign mark is in no list of the stack; every block grown can
be released; the alternative of DS-R9 only drops §76.5, and the one rejected `newStack` (DS07)
fails the guard of §56 alone; `AdminRight` holds on the stack of every `mark`; the block of every
`grow` is held by its recorded destination (no block value is transferred); the mark removed with
an older one is both later in the list and of a higher top.

Not encoded: the draft `case_rewind_reading` (re-encoded with the library, `Witness.reading_above`);
the draft `case_static_before_fail` other than its `push` without room (its `Init`-destination
conjuncts are changed by §77.2); the kernel `newArena` conjuncts of the draft `case_stacks` (the
stack-library state holds no arena registry; the cross-registry cases of §56 are another module).
-/

m and every mark above it"; class Lib). `rewind ⟨0, 1, 1⟩` after `rewind ⟨0, 0, 0⟩`
removed it as a later mark. Expected (DS-v2): `fail`. Obtained: `fail`, with no other outcome (§58;
`rewind_dead_fails`); both marks are gone. Twin: the same sequence without `rewind ⟨0, 0, 0⟩`:
`rewind ⟨0, 1, 1⟩`, `ok`. -/
theorem DS06 : DRunsTo K0 [] ds06o ds06 ∧ ds06.stacks = [⟨1, 5, [2, 3, 4], 0, [], []⟩] ∧
    (RewindStep K0 0 ⟨0, 1, 1⟩ ds06 .fail ∧ ∀ o, RewindStep K0 0 ⟨0, 1, 1⟩ ds06 o → o = .fail) ∧
    DRuns K0 [] (setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 1 5, .mark 0, .kernel (.release 6),
      .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 1⟩]) :=
  ⟨druns (by decide), by decide,
    rewind_dead_fails (st := ⟨1, 5, [2, 3, 4], 0, [], []⟩) (by decide) (by decide),
    druns (by decide)⟩

/-! ## Several stacks (DS-v2; §56) -/

/-- Two stacks (DS-v2, §72, §60, §65, §76 read for a stack): frame 1 with the stack values 0 and 8,
the storages 1 (cells 2, 3, 4) and 9 (cells 10, 11), the destinations 5, 6, 7, 12 (root
authorities 0 on 0, 1 on 1, 2 on 5, 3 on 6, 4 on 7, 5 on 8, 6 on 9, 7 on 12); `internal` 8 on the
cells of 1, stored into 0, stack 0; `internal` 9 on the cells of 9, stored into 8, stack 1. -/
def setup2 : List DOp :=
  [.kernel (.enter [] [lf, lf, pt 1, pt 1, pt 1, lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, pt 9, pt 9, lf]),
    .kernel (.derive 1 [2, 3, 4] .modify), .kernel (.store 8 0), .newStack 1 8,
    .kernel (.derive 6 [10, 11] .modify), .kernel (.store 9 8), .newStack 9 9]
/-- State reached by `setup2` (§57; DS-v2). -/
def ds07 : DState := dfinal K0 [] setup2

/-- **DS07** (draft `case_stacks`, first part; §56 "An authority identity may serve as `internal`
for at most one live administrative abstraction"; class Lib). A second `newStack` with `internal`
8, already the `internal` of the live stack 0. Expected (§56, draft): `reject`. Obtained: `reject`
by the guard of §56 alone: the other preconditions (`NewArenaBase`, §76.1–§76.3, §76.5 and §76.6
read for a stack) hold. Twin: the same sequence without the first registration of 8, `ok`. The draft's
conjuncts on a kernel `newArena` have no counterpart here: the stack-library state holds no arena
